verdict.rationale: Release notes show Postman import and export, including an option to preserve scripts, and the marketing site confirms importing existing Postman collections. Collections are also stored as plain-text Bru files on disk. However, the only portable format evidenced is Postman, and support appears only in thin release-note and marketing mentions. missing for 10: evidence of other formats (OpenAPI/Swagger, Insomnia, cURL, etc.), dedicated import/export documentation, hands-on or independent corroboration of migration fidelity.
